declaration.preface: Saptagir Camphor Private Limited is committed to embedding sustainability into all procurement activities. This Sustainability Procurement Policy defines how we source materials and services responsibly—prioritizing environmental stewardship, ethical labor practices, and long-term value for our stakeholders. By partnering with suppliers who share our vision, we aim to minimize our ecological footprint and uphold the highest standards of integrity.
declaration.declaration: Saptagir Camphor Private Limited is dedicated to ensuring that every procurement decision we make delivers positive outcomes for the environment, society and the local economies in which we operate. Our commitment rests on four interlinked pillars:
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all Saptagir employees, Workers, contractors, Sub-Contractors, suppliers and business partners involved in procurement—across every operational site and manufacturing unit. It governs the full procurement lifecycle, from supplier selection to end-of-life management of goods and services.

Environmental Responsibility in Procurem: Saptagir Camphor Private Limited is committed to minimizing the environmental footprint of its procurement activities by sourcing goods and services from environmentally responsible suppliers.
Incorporate renewable or recycled materials into their products.
Utilize energy-efficient technologies and practices to reduce carbon emissions.
Implement effective waste reduction and responsible waste management systems.
Demonstrate responsible water usage and active water conservation strategies.
Labor Practices and Human Rights: Saptagir Camphor maintains a zero-tolerance policy toward any violations of human rights within its supply chain.
Comply fully with applicable national and international labor laws, including regulations related to wages, working hours, and employee benefits.
Provide a safe and healthy working environment, taking measures to eliminate risks to occupational health and safety.
Strictly prohibit child labor, forced labor, and all forms of human trafficking.
Promote a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring fair treatment and equal opportunity for all, regardless of gender, race, religion, or background.
Ethical Sourcing and Fair Trade: Saptagir Camphor encourages ethical sourcing and the adoption of fair-trade principles across its procurement channels.
Provide fair wages and operate free of exploitative practices.
Support small producers and cooperatives aligned with fair trade standards.
Promote social equity and accountability throughout the supply chain.
Supplier Engagement and Development: We believe in growing together with our partners.
Collaborative initiatives to meet evolving ESG standards and stakeholder expectations.
Supplier performance is regularly reviewed to ensure alignment with our sustainability goals and continuous improvement.
Supplier Assessment: Saptagir Camphor evaluates suppliers’ environmental impact, labor practices, and human rights compliance. This includes site visits, documentation reviews, and third-party certifications. Suppliers are held to high ESG standards through these assessments. Regular evaluations help maintain responsible supplier relationships.
Supplier Code of Conduct: Our Supplier Code of Conduct outlines expectations for environmental responsibility, ethical labor practices, and human rights. All suppliers must sign and comply with this code. It is periodically updated to meet international standards. Compliance is essential for continued supplier partnership.
Capacity Building and Collaboration: We offer training programs and workshops to support suppliers’ sustainability efforts. Knowledge sharing on energy efficiency and carbon reduction is encouraged. Collaboration ensures stronger human rights and labor practices. This fosters mutual growth in the supply chain.
Regular Audits and Corrective Action: Routine audits monitor supplier compliance, especially in high-risk regions. Suppliers are required to address non-compliance through corrective actions. Repeated violations may result in suspension or contract termination. Audits ensure accountability and adherence to ESG standards.
Communication and Transparency: Saptagir Camphor’s Sustainability Procurement Policy will be made publicly available on the company website and communicated to all suppliers and business partners.

Saptagir Camphor’s will ensure that all employees involved in procurement are trained on the principles of sustainable procurement, enabling them to make informed decisions and engage in meaningful dialogue with suppliers.
Continuous Improvement: Saptagir Camphor’s. is committed to continuously improving its procurement practices to drive sustainability and ethical standards throughout the supply chain. As global sustainability challenges evolve, Saptagir Camphor’s will regularly update its policies, engage with suppliers, and leverage innovation to ensure the company remains at the forefront of responsible sourcing.

targets.target: Maintain 75% of suppliers meet Saptagir Camphor’s environmental sustainability criteria
Maintain a 20% reduction in carbon emissions across the supply chain through procurement of energy-efficient materials and services
Maintain a 20% increase in the procurement of renewable or recycled materials

quantitative.area: Labor Practices and Human Rights in Procurement

targets.target: Maintain audits of 100% of high-risk suppliers for compliance with labor practices and human rights standards
Maintain that 100% of suppliers comply with Saptagir Camphor’s standards on fair wages, working conditions, and labor rights
Maintain that 50% of goods sourced from developing regions meet fair trade standards
Annual Supplier Assessments & Audits:100 % of our suppliers will undergo a sustainability assessment and audit every year to verify environmental, social and governance performance.

Certified-Only Sourcing:100 % of our purchased goods and services will be sourced exclusively from suppliers holding a recognized sustainability certification (e.g., ISO 14001, Fair Trade, or equivalent).
Supplier Capacity Building & Training: Ensure 100 % of our suppliers receive basic annual sustainability training and resources to help them meet our environmental and social standards.
Local & Community Sourcing: Commit to sourcing 25 % of our goods and services from local or community-based suppliers—both to boost regional economies and to reduce our carbon footprint.

policy.monitoring:
Supplier Performance Reports: Saptagir Camphor Private Limited will prepare regular performance reports on suppliers’ compliance with environmental, labor, and ethical standards. These reports will be used to inform procurement decisions and foster continuous improvement.

Audit Reports: Results from supplier audits will be reviewed by the Sustainability and Compliance Team, and any non-compliance issues will be addressed immediately through corrective action plans.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Sustainable Procurement Policy will be reviewed annually by the Chief Procurement Officer (CPO). The review will evaluate progress toward the Quantitative targets and assess the policy’s effectiveness in adapting to evolving sustainability challenges. Any necessary updates or adjustments will be made, and changes will be communicated to all employees and suppliers.
